\section{Full simulation results}\label{sec:sims-supp}

This section gives every setting of designs S1 and S2 (Section~\ref{sec:sims}) for every measure of
Section~\ref{sec:sims-metrics}. Entries are averages over the $100$ data sets of a setting, except exact recovery,
which is a count out of $100$. In design S2 the ASI column (marked $\dagger$) is interim: it averages the first $60$ data sets of each setting,
the ones for which ASI had finished when this draft was built, so its exact-recovery counts are out of $60$. The other
five methods use all $100$ data sets, as in Section~\ref{sec:sims}.
